rows.evidence: cmd: SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=$S/sc-referee-pkg contract/fillet-chamfer-evidence/run.sh <tag> (bun drive.mjs, systemd-run 16G cap; 291 cases in cases-results.json; case ids quoted). Interpreter: round(cuboid(40,40,20),4) -> {kind:box,round:4,roundStyle:fillet}. Box 40x40x20 r4: SolidCraft 30711.4969 vs OCCT 30712.2592 and closed form 30712.2592 (rbox formula), dVol 2.5e-5 (curved tessellation bar), faces 26/26/26 (O/brep/truck), brep-rs 1.4e-11. Off-centre 40x30x12 at [15,-7,3] r2.5: 1.8e-5, 26 faces. r5.9: 9.5e-5. r0.05: 1.1e-6, r0.001: 6.6e-9. r=6 (half the 12 thick side): SolidCraft builds 12154.0616 vs closed form 12155.2561 (9.8e-5, 10 faces) while OCCT throws 'radius too big' and brep-rs refuses. Then turn/hole/subtract/join (w-box-then-*): 1.8e-5..3.0e-5 vs OCCT. Caveats: (a) at r<=0.05 the 8 corner patches are typed cone, not sphere, by solidcraft (counts equal 26; geometry within 1.1e-6), the harness flags this as a face-type label mismatch. (b) interpreter lets round(b,-2) through (kernel refuses, see sizes row) and round(b,0) is a silent sharp box (doc round 0 is falsy), which is literally correct. (c) brep-rs silently treats round -2 as +2 (14129.156), irrelevant to SolidCraft.

rows.evidence: cmd: SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=$S/sc-referee-pkg contract/fillet-chamfer-evidence/run.sh <tag> (bun drive.mjs, systemd-run 16G cap; 291 cases in cases-results.json; case ids quoted). d-box-round-chamfer: box 40x40x20 round 4 style chamfer: SolidCraft 29184.0000 (18 faces) vs OCCT = brep-rs 29141.3333 (26 faces), 1.46e-3 apart; offset box 40x30x12 d2: 13792.0000 vs 13786.6667 (3.9e-4). THE TWO REFERENCE KERNELS AGREE AND SOLIDCRAFT DOES NOT, so this is reported WRONG against the oracle. Cause (convention): OCCT/brep-rs add 8 corner triangles that SolidCraft's one-shot chamfer does not; SolidCraft's value equals twelve chamfers applied one by one (ch-bevel-all12-sequential: SolidCraft = OCCT = brep-rs = 13792.0000 exactly) and the half-space intersection. Cylinder style chamfer is fine: 12948.3112 vs closed form 12949.6449 (1.0e-4). LANGUAGE-LAYER LOSS: toScript() of a doc with roundStyle chamfer emits round(b1, 4) (fillet), and re-running it gives roundStyle fillet (checked), so a chamfered primitive silently turns into a fillet on round trip. Script text cannot set roundStyle chamfer on a primitive (round() always writes fillet).

rows.evidence: cmd: SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=$S/sc-referee-pkg contract/fillet-chamfer-evidence/run.sh <tag> (bun drive.mjs, systemd-run 16G cap; 291 cases in cases-results.json; case ids quoted). 20 cases (m-move-*, o-move-then-edge) moving a 40x30x12 box by [10,5,0],[0,0,-4],[0,3,0],[-3,0,0],[5,5,5],[20,0,0],[0,20,0],[0,0,-6],[0,-3,-3],[2,2,0], then fillet top/front and bevel front/right: 8 PASS, 11 REFUSED (misleading 'no edge ... nearest edge N mm away'), 1 SILENTLY WRONG: move [0,-3,-3] then bevel(front,right) d2: SolidCraft 14340.0000, correct 14376.0000 (OCCT = brep-rs = closed form 24 removed): the pick [20,-15,1.9099] was brep-rs's stale coordinate pushed by the retry list (centre + radius*z) onto the wrong 30 mm edge, which was chamfered instead of the 12 mm one (removed 60 instead of 24). Even the 8 passes (e.g. o-move-then-edge) only succeeded because the third retry happened to land within pick tolerance. Cause: brep-rs resolve answers in the named feature's own frame and the translator's multi-candidate retry snaps to the nearest edge. The phase 4 resolver refuses carried names through move/rotate/mirror/pattern (resolve-names.mjs:245,263, read not run) but a primitive name followed by a move was not exercised there by me. Needs a guard (refuse any named edge after a move, or resolve on the moved body) before this ships.

Wherever OCCT builds, SolidCraft agrees (e.g. turn z90 fillet 14374.2309 vs OCCT 14374.2478, 1.2e-6; x90 bevel 14340.0000 exact; cylinder rims 4.1e-5 / 1.1e-4 vs closed form); where OCCT and brep-rs report the edge not found (z45 left/back, x30y20 top/front) SolidCraft refuses too. rows.evidence: cmd: SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=$S/sc-referee-pkg contract/fillet-chamfer-evidence/run.sh <tag> (bun drive.mjs, systemd-run 16G cap; 291 cases in cases-results.json; case ids quoted). cuboid(40,30,12) bevel(top,front,2) then bevel(top,front,1): SolidCraft 14305.8579 (8 faces); OCCT and brep-rs 14320.0000 with 'Bevel 2's edge could not be found'. SolidCraft chamfered the 135-degree edge the first chamfer created (removed 14.142 = 0.5*1*1*sin45*40), i.e. a DIFFERENT edge. bevel then round(top,front,1): SolidCraft 14319.1367 (rounded the neighbouring edge, removed 0.863 = 0.0215 r^2 *40) vs oracles 'not found'. Round r2 then round r1 on the same edge: SolidCraft 14365.6412 = the single fillet, second request silently ignored, oracles say 'Round 2's edge could not be found'. Round then bevel the same edge: SolidCraft refuses (misleading 'nearest edge 6.673 mm away'). Cylinder rim rounded twice: refused. Cause: the pick is brep-rs's centroid of the original edge and solidcraft snaps to the nearest surviving edge. The phase 4 resolver requires the named edge to still exist on the target ('matches no edge ... not guessing', resolve-names.mjs:333, read not run), so this may be closed in the shipping path; it is open in the rig.
